headline: Policy Committee advanced five proposed bylaws and bylaw revisions to the Board of Education for Second Read.
summary: The Policy Committee reviewed three new proposed bylaws and revisions to two existing bylaws, all based on CABE and Shipman models. Each item will move forward to the Board of Education for Second Read at the next Instructional Committee Meeting. The committee also reviewed technical edits to Policy 1110.2 on Parent Portal Acceptable Use and Safety.
decisions: Recommended Proposed New Bylaw 9327.1 on Board Member Use of Internet Social Networks move forward to the Board of Education for Second Read.
Recommended Proposed New Bylaw 9325.5 on Request for Information by Board Members move forward to the Board of Education for Second Read.
Recommended Proposed New Bylaw 9313 on Formulation, Adoption, Amendment of Administrative Regulations move forward to the Board of Education for Second Read.
Recommended Proposed Revisions to Bylaw 9326 on Minutes move forward to the Board of Education for Second Read.
Recommended Proposed Revisions to Bylaw 9327 on Electronic Mail Communications move forward to the Board of Education for Second Read.
